audience: data and engineering teams that check the setup of a Segment workspace

useCases.title: Find disabled sources and the destinations they feed
useCases.text: List the sources of the workspace and see which ones are disabled. For each source, list the destinations connected to it.

useCases.title: Review the tracking plans of the workspace
useCases.text: List the tracking plans with their last update times. Open one plan to read its name, description and type.

useCases.title: Map the warehouses to the sources that sync into them
useCases.text: List the connected warehouses and their status. List the sources that sync into one warehouse, with their sync settings.

useCases.title: Trace a destination back to its source
useCases.text: Read the workspace to confirm the connection. Then get one destination with its settings and the source it is connected to.
